name: Crew Control
features:
Agreed with the player (stages 1-3 done). Build ALL of these. (The v0.6.2 hotfix already fixed deadhead reachability: planOut/outTicket() in crew/timeline.ts searches all ticket times and gives exact reasons — build on it, don't regress it. ALSO switch ops/events.ts crewReadyAt (crew-short wait estimates) from the old 3 h-buffer guess to outTicket().)

CREW SHORTAGE AS A SERIOUS SITUATION ('Crew Control'):
1. WARNING LADDER: amber warning when a shortage is detected (up to ~48 h ahead), escalating to red + auto-pause (existing crewShortage pause setting) at ~12 h to departure; a clear 'CREW SHORTAGE' banner on the flight (map panel, schedule block, Up Next) and in the top bar's pause badge; inbox message with the flight, missing seats and time left. (A distinct crew-shortage SOUND comes with the v0.9 sound set — leave a hook.)
2. CREW CONTROL PANEL (opened from the warning/badge/flight): shows exactly which seats are missing (e.g. 1 CPT, 2 CC) and the ranked SOLUTIONS, each with cost, timing and consequences, one tap to apply, with a preview of what changes:
   a. AUTO-FIX: re-run the auto-roster for this flight (and its pairing) and show what it changed.
   b. DEADHEAD SOMEONE: candidate list with each person's commercial itinerary, arrival time and legality after it (uses the v0.6.2 logic).
   c. DELAY UNTIL CREW ARRIVES: new departure time, delay cost / client penalty and knock-on effects on later legs (ripple), confirm.
   d. PRIVATE JET POSITIONING: charter a business jet to fly the crew to the departure airport. Available ANY TIME, priced so it only makes sense when urgent (realistic charter rates ~5-8k USD per flight hour incl. positioning of the jet itself; light/midsize/heavy jet by crew count and range; departs within ~2-3 h from a nearby FBO). ON THE MAP it shows exactly like the commercial deadheads (floating label, thin dotted path, tap panel with times/time to landing/crew aboard) BUT with its own small BUSINESS-JET icon and the label/panel naming a chartered private jet (e.g. 'Private jet · Citation XLS' or a realistic charter operator name) instead of an airline. Rosters show it as a positioning/deadhead block. Costs through the ledger.
   e. CALL IN STANDBY / DAY-OFF CREW: overtime pay and a morale hit (v0.6 morale system).
   f. COMMANDER'S DISCRETION: extend the FDP by up to 2 h where legal (existing applyDiscretion), with fatigue/morale effect.
   g. SWAP CREWS: take a crew set from another flight and show what that flight then needs.
   h. SUB-CHARTER TO A RIVAL: a rival flies it at their price (existing subcharter).
   i. CANCEL: penalty and reputation hit.
3. The bot uses Crew Control sensibly; balance stays in band; old saves load.

PLAIN-LANGUAGE ISSUES (player request, agreed 'try all 8, refine later'; the player is a former cabin crew member, not a planner: NO jargon lists, ONE simple story per problem, visual aids). Apply to every crew problem (crew shortage, illegal/tight crew, 'can't reach', rest, FDP, sick, resigned):
4. 'WHAT'S WRONG?' CARD, always the same four lines, shown on the Crew Control panel, the flight sheet, the duty modal and the inbox message: WHAT ('AWQ816 has no pilots'), WHY in one sentence a layperson understands ('Your free pilots are in Lisbon and the earliest they can land in Düsseldorf is 11:40, 3 h after the latest 08:34'), DOES IT HURT? (money + passengers + delay, e.g. 'Not much: empty flight, ~3 h late, no penalty' or 'Yes: 180 passengers, $42K penalty'), WHAT YOU CAN DO (the solution buttons). One main cause only; details behind a 'Details' tap.
5. REACH TIMELINE BAR for 'can't get there in time': a horizontal bar with now, must-land-by, report, departure, earliest arrival; the gap drawn in red; labels in UTC and local.
6. GAUGES for the limits: a fuel-gauge style bar for FDP ('Day length 10:45 of 11:00'), rest ('Rest 7:30 of 10:00 by 06:00'), 7-day/28-day block hours; green/amber/red; shown per crew member in the duty modal and on the card when the cause is a limit.
7. MINI-MAP on the card for location/positioning causes: the crew member's dot, a dashed line to where they're needed, the flight (airline or private jet) they would take, with times.
8. ONE REASON PER PERSON in the candidate list and Adjust crew, with an icon: wrong place / needs rest / day too long / busy on another flight / sick / not rated / on leave. Pick the ROOT cause (a pilot busy on another trip is 'busy on AWQ815 to London until 10:30', never 'At LIS, not DUS'). Tap the person for the full list.
9. TAP-TO-EXPLAIN GLOSSARY: tapping FDP, deadhead, positioning, tight, discretion, ACMI, wet lease, sub-charter, AOG, standby, rest, block hours shows a one-line plain meaning (small popover, dismiss by tapping elsewhere). Terms are rendered via one <Term> component so the glossary is one table.
10. 'DOES IT HURT?' SEVERITY in money and passengers on every crew warning and inbox message (badge: 'no cost', '$12K', '180 pax', '2 h late').
11. COLOUR LEGEND in Schedule, Roster board and the map crew layer (small '?' button): what red, amber, grey, dotted and solid mean.
(Already fixed in v0.6.3/v0.6.4, in the tree: flightCrewStatus confirms stored illegal/tight marks live via crewIssuesFor/liveCrewLevel — keep it.)

PLAIN LANGUAGE EVERYWHERE (player: 'inside v0.7.1'): extend the same four-line card, <Term> glossary and severity badges to EVERY kind of problem:
12. MAINTENANCE: AOG, check due/overdue, check booking clashes, no slot ('CS-THB can't fly: a brake fault in Lisbon. Repair ~9 h. Hurts: 2 flights, 230 passengers, $38K'), with a timeline bar (fault → repair → next flight) and a gauge for check intervals ('A-check: 82% used').
13. CONTRACTS: feasibility warnings on offers (crew short, aircraft busy, range, cabin mismatch, paint), counter-offer expiry, change requests, penalties, cancellations — one plain sentence each + what it costs + the button that fixes it.
14. MONEY: cash warnings, overdue invoices, loss months, lease/deposit due, covenant/goal misses: the card says what happens if ignored and the exact date.
15. AIRCRAFT/DELIVERY: delivery delays, ferry, refit, lease return conditions.
16. INBOX: every warn/bad message carries the card (collapsed) and a severity badge; a filter 'Problems only'; tap 'Explain' on any message.
17. GLOSSARY SCREEN under Settings: all terms with one-line meanings and a 'show me' link to where they appear.
18. A 'WHY?' button on every red/amber dot anywhere (schedule, fleet, crew, map) that opens the card.
19. First-time hints: the first time each kind of problem appears, a one-paragraph plain explanation with a picture (the same visuals), 'don't show again'.
Keep: calm visuals, iPad landscape, real names, speeds 1/2/4 only. Bot and balance unchanged; old saves load.

ALSO: add a v0.7.1 entry at the top of src/data/whatsNew.ts (features + improvements in player words; it drives the 'What's new' pop-up) and set CURRENT accordingly; update the Title footer version via that data.
